svg.aria-label: As-built ACME City Permits architecture. Four signed-in personas and public visitors act in the browser. The FastAPI service governs permit, registry, finance, agent, policy, insight and operations work, and serves the applicant help assistant and the City of Acme website. Meta Muse Spark proposes and Muse Image draws permit-type icons outside the application. Simulated source systems and six simulated subscriber departments sit outside the application, and evidence is collected separately.
